note: Internal map of a pure deterministic script: one flow, no coordinator, no sub-agents, no model step. Authored from what the agent does (its future-state steps, its transformation map and its build-spec), not converted from the earlier plugin-shaped graph.

header.source_of_truth_note: This graph object is the authored source of truth for the internal map. The diagram (HTML + SVG), agents.yaml and dag-coverage-manifest.md are renders of it by renderer/render_internal_dag.py.
header.zero_agent_action_boundary: The script writes to no original or live file and holds no decision. Its only outputs are the Sheet and Slides review copies and the run log it creates for each run (one draft surface, never a system write), handed to the owner's review process; people promote, share and distribute.
header.coordination_shape: one fixed sequence: a single flow started by its entry trigger, with one readiness gate that either stages the review copies or stops and escalates

coordination_shapes_rejected.rejection_rationale: every agent-taken step in the transformation map is script-eligible and there are no sub-agent groups, so there is nothing to dispatch between

coordination_shapes_rejected.shape: a model step (single agent with tools)
coordination_shapes_rejected.rejection_rationale: the ratified remit has no judgment step anywhere: retrieval, computation, template fill and logging are deterministic

header.router_type: none: one flow, started by its entry trigger
header.routing_state_observability: Not applicable: a single flow has no routing state to read.

r2_backbone_reconciliation.declared_surface: The build-spec declares no sub-agent surface (sub_agent_surface.declared: false, primitive_form: script).
r2_backbone_reconciliation.this_stage_realizes: One flow band of code steps; no root_agent, no sub_agents. People's steps (screenshot, share link, distribution) stay outside the agent and are named in the owner's review seam.

mapping.build_spec.sub_agent_surface: declared false: realized as the single flow (s-retrieve to s-stage-1-recommend / s-stage-2-escalate)
mapping.build_spec.tool_permission_inventory.mus: no write edge or write interface; the review copies and run log are the draft surface IW-1
mapping.build_spec.integrations (access_mode: re: Salesforce as IR-1; Google Slides, Sheets and Drive templates and history as IR-2; access stays in assumptions
mapping.build_spec.decision_rules (cap 3-8, room: rule_set_ref values are references only; the computation and readiness rules are the deepen stage's

r2_backbone_reconciliation.surface_evidence_state_lift: Nothing to lift: no surface was declared.

header.people_steps_note: Outside the script and unchanged: the brand-awareness dashboard and its screenshot, inserting the screenshot, copying the share link and the Slack distribution (future-state steps n-step-1-1-1, n-step-1-1-2, n-step-1-2-2, n-step-2-1-7, n-step-3-1-1 to n-step-3-1-5). They pick up once the review copies exist.

nodes.title: Retrieve the pipeline influence report
nodes.input: The reporting period for the run (via IC-1).
nodes.output: The report's exact values for the period, before rounding.

nodes.title: Compute the three metrics
nodes.input: The retrieved report values, the accepted templates and the prior-period pack (IR-2).
nodes.output: Qualified Pipeline Generated, Pipeline Influenced and Closed-Won Influenced, with zero, unavailable and not-calculable kept apart.

nodes.title: Ready to stage?
nodes.condition: escalate when a required metric's report mapping is unresolved or a core input or template is missing; otherwise stage the review copies
nodes.output: Routes the run to staging or to the escalation. It routes; it decides nothing for the owner.

nodes.title: Write the Sheet and Slides review copies and the run log
nodes.input: The computed metrics (staging path from eg-1).
nodes.output: A Sheet review copy and a Slides review copy for the period with the computed values, plus the run log and reconciliation record beside them.

nodes.title: Record the stop and hand over the escalation
nodes.output: A run log entry naming what blocked the run and the evidence behind it; no cause is invented and no copy is staged.

nodes.title: Owner checks, promotes and distributes
nodes.input: The review copies and run log via IH-1.
nodes.output: The reporting owner checks values, exceptions and layout, then promotes the copies; people add the screenshot, copy the share link and distribute in Slack.

nodes.title: Owner resolves the blocker
nodes.output: The owner corrects the source or mapping and asks for a new run; an unexplained discrepancy goes to the Performance Investigator. The script never self-corrects.

edges.condition: every required input and mapping is present
edges.source: proposed readiness policy, pending the deepen stage

edges.condition: a required mapping or core input is missing
